thread:
alex_c: Quick heads-up — I'm OOO next Wed (travel). Can we swap ARB facilitator that week? Also thinking of trying an 'anchor' role so someone owns start/end and timeboxing. TL;DR: need facilitator + anchor + trimmed agenda.
maria_k: +1 on anchor idea. what's the facilitator slot length? usually 45m.
jamal_r: I can cover facilitator if needed. Also +1 for a tighter agenda. propose: 1) 5m quick triage, 2) 25m RFC deep dive, 3) 10m lightning reads, 4) 5m actions.
sophie_p: I'm happy to be anchor (start/end + timekeeper) :raised_hands:
tess_ops: can we add "canary rollout checklist" to triage items? small item, 5m.
alex_c: thanks @sophie_p! @jamal_r would you take facilitator? if yes i'll update calendar and agenda.
jamal_r: yep I can facilitate. calendar poll? here's a quick poll: https://doodle.com/poll/arb-week-2023
maria_k: also, suggest we put the agenda template in the meeting description so ppl can add pre-reads. snippet:
```text
Agenda:
- 00:00 - 00:05: Roll call + triage (owner: anchor)
- 00:05 - 00:30: RFC review (presenter)
- 00:30 - 00:40: Lightning reads (2-3x 3-5m)
- 00:40 - 00:45: Actions & owners
Pre-reads: link to RFCs
```
jamal_r: perfect. can we try strict timeboxing this week? I'll set 40m cap.
sophie_p: noted. I'll own timekeeping and flag overruns in the thread.
arb-bot: New event created: "Architecture Review Board — 2023-11-15" (event id: ev_8873)
tess_ops: tiny ask — can we rotate anchor every 2 meetings? keeps exposure balanced.
alex_c: love that. let's do a 2-meeting anchor rotation. I'll update the facilitator rotation doc after the event.
maria_k: who'll own rotating facilitator roster? volunteering myself for roster upkeep.
jamal_r: thanks all. I'll update calendar + agenda this afternoon and post links here.
sophie_p: thanks! :party_parrot:
